reviews.review_msg: great prof from first look. extremly informative, extremly smart and caring, great teaching methods. Just make sure you study, attend class, practice what you learn. Cheers.

Dr. Soltanshah really cares about the students not just there for teaching to get his job done, he gives thoughtful advices and the class is very interesting. Exams were fair, assignments were fair. Overall very nice and good prof.

Very structured, solid introduction to AI. Some parts of the course use UC Berkeley's material so it's a high qualitt course (You get more than what you pay for). Quizzes are easy, activities are easy, weekly modules are thorough. Assignments are fun, and exams are totally fair. He's the goat.

Mohammad was a great prof for 310 which is a very interesting but also difficult class. Assignment and group project guidelines are clear, he is quick to answer questions, grading is fair, exams are pretty hard but overall pretty fair, lectures are solid but not mandatory, group project and individual assignments are interesting. Would recommend.

Prof will take attendance if lecture numbers are low and gives out bonus marks to in class participation. Really clear lectures and easy to understand assignments. Exams are all based on the worksheets and assignments given. Quizzes were open book on canvas based on lectures. Prof is really responsive and easy to approach. nice chill guy
